svg.title: Project 10, the emerald dragon, in six pictures on medium skin. 1: a light sketch: the scale area from the forehead around the temple to the jaw, the horn line and the center line, with the eye area kept clear. 2: a sponge blend of lime, emerald and deep teal over the scale area, darker toward the jaw. 3: scales, row by row, with a stencil or freehand, fading into the skin at the edges. 4: gold horns shaded dark on one side and light on the other, with ridges, and a column of gold spikes down the center. 5: a black line along the inner edge of the scales and eye-safe liner with a sharp flick. Done: white and gold highlight dots, sparkles and a gem between the brows.
